name: AUCMA Co.,Ltd.
summary: AUCMA Co.,Ltd. primarily manufactures and sells refrigeration business in China and internationally. The company offers air conditioning and washing machines; a single door, double door, three doors, five doors, and dual and variable-temperature freezers, as well as wine coolers; commercial and medical cold chains; and ultra-low temperature equipment. It also provides vending machines, special purpose cars, smart bathrooms, clothing care machines, kitchen appliances, small kitchen electricity, integrated stoves, and smart home products; and water heater, kitchen, small, home, and healthy water appliances. AUCMA Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1987 and is based in Qingdao, China.
